args.message: Address entry helper review: name amount units and reject negatives

args.body: Renamed the parameter and its references from `amt` to `amount_cents` in `ledger/entries.py`. Added regression coverage using the `amount_cents` keyword, plus positional-call coverage. Local validation: `python -m pytest -q` — 6 passed. Submitted to the PR branch `entry-helper`.

Added a negative-amount guard that raises `ValueError` before creating an entry. Zero and positive amounts remain valid; no refund behavior was introduced. Added regression cases for -1 and -1250 as well as zero and positive values. Local validation: `python -m pytest -q` — 6 passed. Submitted to the PR branch `entry-helper`.
